schemes.APIKeyHeader.description: "API key authentication using the ShippoToken scheme.
Format: Authorization: ShippoToken <API_TOKEN>
Example: Authorization: ShippoToken shippo_live_abc123
"

schemes.JWTAuth.description: "Short-lived JSON Web Token authentication, intended for client-side applications.
Mint a token with POST /embedded/authz, then send it on subsequent requests.
Format: Authorization: JWT <JWT_TOKEN>
Tokens are valid for 12 hours.
"
schemes.shippoOAuth.description: "OAuth2 authentication with Shippo.\nUsers will be redirected to Shippo to authorize access to their account.\n"
